system.description:
You channel compressed Plasma into a shield of light, protecting yourself or an allied creature from fatal harm. As a reaction to damage being dealt to you or an allied creature you can see that is within 20 feet of a Starlight. The protected creature gains 3d6 temporary hit points, and the attacking creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Blinded until the beginning of your next turn. Increase the temporary hit points gained to 5d6 at 7th level and 7d6 at 15th level.

| #### Event Horizon / Battle Amp / Your Body radiates light so intensely, it becomes imperceivable as you radiate an aura closer to that of a blackholes. For the duration you gain the following benefits. You gain additional benefits based on the number of Starlight’s consumed. / Stellar Presence. Creatures within 40 feet of you cannot gain the benefits of being invisible you gain immunity to the Blinded and Dazzled conditions. / Transcendent Charge. At the beginning of each of your turns, you can summon 2 Starlight’s instead of one. / Infinite Horizon. Once per round, on your turn, you can gain 2 Stellar Charges, from any one trigger of your choice. / Starlight’s Consumed / 1 Starlight. Up to twice per turn, on your turn, by spending 10 feet of movement or by spending a reaction at the beginning of other creatures turn, you can teleport to one active Starlight, into a space affected by the Starlight’s light. / 2 Starlight’s. Convergence can now trigger on any damage, regardless of the effects keyword. Select the effect you want to apply when its triggered, even if its triggered by another creature. / 3 Starlight’s. All active Starlight’s can enter Fusion of Fission. If you choose to do this, All creatures that are Converged are teleported into a space of your choice, as close to a Starlight as possible. / 4 Starlight’s. You can maintain Starlight Fission’s or Fusions, for the duration of your Event Horizon, instead of them detonating at the beginning of your next turn. |
